title: 収穫日は、約束できるか
state: 最初の播種から14〜21日。まだ収穫しない。28日見込みを確定日と呼ばない。36日目に十二食を三階集結所へ届ける候補。

dialogue: 次の遠征に、二十食頼めるか。
決まった日に、同じ品質で。
scenes.description: Leon enters diner in navy cloak, scar on right eyebrow, no sword, supply notebook in hand; Elna and Kou behind counter listen. Two panels wider arrival then restrained serious face.

dialogue: 庭葉は、そろそろ採れるはず。
その『はず』、どこまで確か？
scenes.description: Kou looks toward small green plot hopefully, Iris beside him holds observation notebook, medium face then narrow hand closeup calendar sketch. No harvested basket, plants still growing.

dialogue: 光が違う。日付だけじゃ読めん。
scenes.description: Same bed has visibly shadier corner under tower rib, plants in that section smaller; Balt points upward at shadow boundary, Kou measures a leaf gently. Two unequal closeups and one contextual view.

dialogue: 二十八日は、見込みだった。
遅れた場合も、計算し直す。
scenes.description: Kou and Elna at table with crop notebook, crossed-out estimate and alternative schedule shown only as abstract marks, closeup uncertain thoughtful Kou then Elna listening. No false exact harvest-day projection.

dialogue: 二十食は、まだ約束できません。
出せる数と、代わりの手を聞こう。
scenes.description: Three unequal conversation panels at diner: Kou honest serious, Leon watching without anger, Elna anxious then relieved. No humiliation or cartoon villain stance.

dialogue: 量と値段も、先に決めよう。
scenes.description: Elna negotiates with local produce supplier at back door, Balt nearby discusses existing stock, Kou checks ledger. Baskets represent supplier's mature crops, not main plot magically grown.

dialogue: 今日は、この苗を間引く。
育つ場所を、残してやれ。
scenes.description: Two closeups and quiet medium panel: Kou carefully thins crowded SMALL garden-leaf seedlings, Elna holds tray for removed seedlings away from future food; path not trodden over bed. No harvesting immature plants for order.

dialogue: まず、一便だけ。十二食だ。
畑も、仕入れも確認します。
scenes.description: Large dignified scene in diner: Leon offers small plain contract, Kou and Elna accept together, modest vegetable beds seen outside. Hands coherent, no ornate reward trophy or huge coin shower.
